model: 62DA/DB/DC/DD 07-38 Dedicated Outdoor Air Unit (I/O Flex 6126, 100% OA program)
applies_to: Carrier 62DA, 62DB, 62DC and 62DD 07-38 vertical or horizontal 100% outdoor air units, with optional energy conservation wheel, controlled by the I/O Flex 6126 running the 100% OA standard program.
summary: The 62D DOAS is run by an I/O Flex 6126 controller that can talk BACnet MS/TP (and Modbus, N2 or LonWorks). The manual's mapping appendix lists 52 BACnet objects (AVs and BVs) for the 100% outdoor air program: schedule source and BAS run command, leaving air, outdoor and room setpoints, sensor values, compressor, heat, reheat and fan commands, and an alarm code.
notes: Form 62D-1T (1-12, 2-12 reprint), Appendix E, a rotated table that also gives Modbus registers, N2 and LonWorks SNVTs; only the BACnet type:ID and object names are used here.
Access comes from the table's read-only column (marked rows are read-only); rows the table lists as inputs polled from the BAS are writable.
No units column is printed. Descriptions combine the printed point name and its description.
The integration guide says the factory should supply an object listing for the job; check it against this table, as the program can differ by order.
The BACview example shows device instance 1612804 with Autogenerate Device ID = Y; the instance is not a fixed default.

source.title: 62DA,DB,DC,DD07-38 Dedicated Vertical or Horizontal 100% Outdoor Air Unit with Optional Energy Conservation Wheel - Controls and Start-Up (Appendix E: BACnet/Modbus/N2/LonWorks Mapping 100% OA STD 021711)

integration.summary: Set the I/O Flex 6126 address and MS/TP baud with its rotary and DIP switches, set BAS Enable to Yes and the schedule source (SCS) to 2 = BAS. The BMS then runs the unit with BV 1 and writes leaving air, outdoor air and room setpoints; read operating mode, leaving air and outdoor temperatures, fan command and the alarm code.

minimum_points.name: ctrl_source_1
minimum_points.why: Schedule source; 2 = BAS controls the unit

integration.enable: On the BACview Schedule screen set SCS to 2 (BAS) so another control system operates the unit; BAS Enable must be Yes in the configuration. SCS is also exposed as AV 15 (ctrl_source_1) and the BAS run command as BV 1 (enable_bas_1).
setup: Address: tens and ones rotary switches on the I/O Flex 6126 (factory setting 02); the controller reads the address only after a power cycle.
Baud: Comm Selector DIP switches SW1-SW2 (9600, 19.2k, 38.4k or 76.8k; factory 38.4k). SW5-SW8 select BACnet MS/TP master or slave; master is recommended.
For MS/TP, wire to Port 2a (Net+, Net-, Gnd) with the same polarity throughout, set the duplex switch to half (two-wire) and the communications jumper to EIA-485. Port 1 is for ARC156 only.
The BACview BACnet screen shows the device instance and whether it is autogenerated.
gotchas: Room control override only works when both BAS Room Ctrl and Room Ctrl are set to Yes.
Points depend on unit options (wheel, reheat, heat type, VFD, RH and CO2 sensors).
